author: Subscriptor
body:
I'm really sad, i dont think the staff team does not think enough before taking a major action. It's completely stupid imo.
First, you demote one of the best Senior Moderators that actually got stuff done, and then he's being banned... 
Right after he is being perma banned for leaking? or it's a misunderstanding, or the ban is unjustified , or please explain me and provide some explaination if possible, because from my point of view atm, it seems completely pointless to me. Maybe it's because i dont know whats going "behind the scenes" but im sorry, jack was actually the best sr mod ive ever seen on this server. I'm dissapointed seeing him being demoted, please check twice before demoting such great staff members. I'm really dissapointed and i will be unless ill be given proof (if not confidential) i will keep thinking its really useless. Thats what i think. Please dont just lock this post and all staff just dont archive, i want a real discussion here , i honestly just want to know the reason for his demotion and his ban, because for me it seems so stupid to take such an action.

Express your honest opinion please, and explain me about the situation more if possible.


-Eric
